description: Source code implementing input event classes for Chromium, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen interactions, used within Playwright's Chromium server component.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements keyboard input handling for Chromium, including key down, key up, and text input.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Handles mouse input events such as move, down, up, and wheel for Chromium.

classes.name: RawTouchscreenImpl
classes.description: Handles touchscreen tap events for Chromium.

methods.name: _commandsForCode
methods.description: Generates command list based on key code and modifiers, specific to Mac.

methods.name: keydown
methods.description: Dispatches a key down event with modifiers and key info.

methods.name: move
methods.description: Moves mouse cursor to specified coordinates.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a touchscreen tap at specified coordinates.
